main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-done pitch section before Thursday's deadline given D's bereavement, and whether D should finish it tonight.

A-B.evidence: A pushes D to hand off or finish tonight (T3, T9); B declines to take over (T4) and questions D working tonight (T10), a partial divergence.

A-C.evidence: A asks for someone to take over (T3); C declines to take the section (T5) but they don't address each other and C says nothing further.

A-D.evidence: A rejects finishing tomorrow night (T7); D concedes and offers to finish tonight (T8); A thanks D (T9), so they end on the same plan.

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take D's section (T4, T5); they don't address each other, but the positions match.

B-D.evidence: B asks if D is sure and says they should be with family (T10); D answers (T12); B accepts 'Okay' (T13); D thanks B (T14).

C-D.evidence: C says they can't take the section (T5) and D replies 'I understand' (T6), but C says nothing about D's final plan.
